jobs.title: Utilities Industry ArcGIS Consultant
jobs.description:
**The Work:**


Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com.

  

Within Accenture's Utilities Practice, We use our deep industry expertise in digital customer engagement and operations, connected energy services and customer platforms to help retail energy and utility providers with cost effectiveness, revenue assurance/extension and customer satisfaction and loyalty. Transmission \& distribution (T\&D) organizations must innovate, invest strategically, and modernize infrastructure to balance supply and demand, optimize assets and teams, and drive towards net\-zero emissions. Learn more about Accenture's Utilities Transmission \& Distribution Practice here\>\> Transmission \& Distribution \| Accenture

**You Are:**


The ArcGIS Utility Network Consultant will support the design, configuration, and implementation of ArcGIS Utility Network solutions for electric and gas utility clients. Working alongside senior solution architects and project leadership, this role will help clients modernize legacy GIS environments while supporting the transition from traditional geometric network models to the ArcGIS Utility Network platform.

  

The Consultant will contribute to functional design, business process analysis, application configuration, testing, and implementation activities while partnering with client stakeholders and cross\-functional delivery teams. This role offers the opportunity to work on large\-scale utility transformation programs focused on improving grid operations, asset management, field mobility, and enterprise GIS capabilities.

 **The Work:**

* Support the implementation of ArcGIS Utility Network solutions for electric and gas utility clients.
* Participate in requirements gathering, business process analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment activities.
* Assist in translating utility business requirements into ArcGIS Utility Network capabilities and functional workflows.
* Support the migration from legacy GIS environments (including ArcGIS Geometric Network) to ArcGIS Utility Network using industry best practices.
* Collaborate with senior solution architects, technical teams, and client stakeholders to deliver high\-quality GIS solutions.
* Contribute to workshops, design sessions, system demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and end\-user training activities.
* Support integration efforts between GIS and enterprise platforms including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Work Management, Outage Management Systems (OMS), Customer Information Systems (CIS), and field mobility solutions.
* Develop project documentation, functional specifications, process flows, and client\-ready deliverables.
* Collaborate across business and technology teams to help clients modernize GIS capabilities and improve operational performance.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements


  

**Here's What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing ArcGIS Utility Network solutions within electric or gas utilities.
* Experience supporting GIS implementation, business analysis, functional design, configuration, testing, or deployment activities.
* Strong understanding of utility operational processes including engineering, asset management, field operations, construction, maintenance, or outage management.
* Experience working with ArcGIS Utility Network (required).
* Experience with the Esri platform (preferred), including one or more of:



	+ ArcGIS Enterprise
	+ ArcGIS Pro
	+ ArcGIS Experience Builder
	+ ArcGIS Field Maps
	+ ArcGIS Workforce
	+ ArcGIS Survey123
* Understanding of Utility Network concepts including:



	+ Network topology
	+ Asset and device modeling
	+ Network rules
	+ Network tracing
	+ Branch versioning
* Experience supporting integrations between GIS and enterprise systems.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an, Associate’s Degree with 6 years of work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* You have experience working for a utility, consulting firm, or Esri implementation partner.
* You have experience supporting ArcGIS Utility Network migrations from ArcGIS Geometric Network.
* You have exposure to Digital As\-Builts, Field Mapping, Mobile Workforce Management, or Utility Engineering workflows.
* You have experience working with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Maximo, IFS, Oracle Utilities, IBM, or Hexagon.
* You have familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and modern software implementation practices.
* You have experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools, automation, or analytics to improve project delivery or operational performance.
* You have relevant Esri certifications or active pursuit of Esri training and certifications.

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as se

jobs.title: GIS Specialist IV
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

AECOM is actively seeking a talented, energetic technology\-minded Geographic Information System (GIS) professional for immediate employment in the Marine Corps Base (MCB) Camp Pendleton Installation Geospatial Information \& Services (IGI\&S) office as a seconded employee. The GIS Specialist is a full\-time AECOM employee that will report to the Associate Vice President \& GIS Sr Manager in the Technology Services Group and will support our United States Marine Corps (USMC) client within the Environment Business line. This position will lead a team of GIS Specialists supporting the MCB Camp Pendleton IGI\&S Program with GIS data management, geospatial analysis and modeling, cartographic product development, and technical support. A successful candidate will work independently and in close coordination with the IGI\&S manager and their staff to develop, deploy and support GIS across the installation. The position requires a professional with project management experience, a solid foundation in GIS, team leadership, project communication, and a commitment to quality.

 **Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

  

* Perform data conversion, migration, and exploitation activities using advanced geospatial processing techniques
* Gather, review, and report on technical requirements to meet project goals and implement quality assurance procedures
* Prepare project plans to successfully execute assigned work
* Work with junior staff to ensure quality in all work products and development technical quality review procedures
* Work directly with government staff to plan for and execute mission objectives
* Maintain quality assurance of spatial and non\-spatial data and processes as per defined standards Maintain expertise in existing and emerging GIS related software and technologies
* Create and maintain GIS data in an ArcGIS enterprise environment
* Apply attention to detail with proactive and resourceful problem\-solving skills
* Communicating and collaborating with the project manager, project team, and client stakeholders to understand and document system/solution requirements
* Research and compile data from various sources
* Develop visualizations and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, ArcGIS Pro, or Portal for ArcGIS to effectively communicate findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholder
* Organize, document, and communicate status updates to program leaders and relevant project teams
* Provide excellent team leadership, critical thinking, decision\-making, conflict resolution, and analytical skills
* Read, comprehend, and extract utility information from engineering drawings.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* BA/BS \+ 6 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
* 2\+ YORE of GIS project management experience
* Valid Driver’s License and as a condition of employment must be able to pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records review.
* Due to the nature of work, US Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency with applications such as:
	+ ArcGIS Enterprise, Pro, and Desktop Software
	+ Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D/AutoCAD Map
	+ Experience with Autodesk Connector for ArcGIS
* Experience with GPS data collection processes and the ability to lead teams in the field
* Comfortable working outside and/or traveling occasionally to support field activities
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced multi\-tasking environment
* Maintain expertise in existing and emerging geospatial software and technologies
* Understanding of relational database organization, design, and functionality
* Ability to learn and present best practices for data management including workflows, tools, governance models, and integration patterns
* GIS data management, technical writing, and geodatabase design experience
* Demonstrated knowledge of cartographic design and production concepts and principles
* Demonstrated experience with the Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment (SDSFIE)
* Project management experience in the field of GIS
* Experience leading a team of GIS professionals
* Excellent communication skills

  

**Additional Information**  

* Relocation is not available for this position.
* Sponsorship is not available for this position


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business t

jobs.title: GIS Specialist (Multiple Levels)
jobs.description:
Overview:
**GIS Specialist (Multiple Levels)** **Remote \| Western U.S. Natural Resources Programs**  

NV5 is seeking GIS Specialists at various career levels to support natural resource management, environmental planning, conservation, and land management initiatives across the Western United States. These positions offer the opportunity to work with multidisciplinary teams delivering geospatial solutions that support federal clients.  

Successful candidates will have experience with GIS technologies, geospatial data management, analysis, and application development. Opportunities are available for early\-career, mid\-level, and senior professionals, with responsibilities aligned to experience and technical expertise. **Work Environment:*** Location: Remote \| Western U.S. Natural Resources Programs
* Travel \<10% of the time (some occasional on\-site visits required).


NV5 is a global technology solutions and consulting services company with a workforce of over 4,500 professionals in more than 100 offices worldwide. NV5’s continued growth has been spurred through strategic investments in firms with unique capabilities to help current and future customers solve the world’s toughest problems. The NV5 family brings together talent across a wide range of markets and fields, including Professional Engineers, Professional Land Surveyors, Architects, Photogrammetrists, GIS Professionals, Software Developers, IT, Project Management Professionals, and more.  

At NV5 Geospatial, We are a collaboration of intelligent, innovative thinkers who care for each other, our communities, and the environment. We value both heart and head, the diversity of our people, and their experiences because that is how we continue to grow as a leader in our industry and expand our individual and collective potential.
Responsibilities:

Depending on experience level, responsibilities may include:  

* Supporting GIS projects for natural resource, environmental, land management, and conservation programs.
* Developing, maintaining, and analyzing geospatial datasets and databases.
* Creating maps, dashboards, web applications, and other GIS products for clients and project teams.
* Configuring and supporting ArcGIS desktop, web, and mobile applications.
* Assisting with GIS workflows, data collection efforts, and field support activities.
* Developing technical documentation, user guides, workflows, and project deliverables.
* Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Supporting project planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Contributing to process improvements and innovative geospatial solutions.
* For senior\-level candidates, providing technical leadership, project oversight, mentoring, and coordination of GIS development and deployment activities.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications**  

Candidates should demonstrate professional experience in one or more of the following areas:* Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and geospatial analysis.
* Bachelor’s degree in geography, natural resource management or equivalent; a master’s degree is desirable
* Working with Esri software products including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, and/or mobile GIS applications.
* GIS data management, editing, quality control, and cartographic production.
* Web GIS application configuration and deployment.
* Technical documentation, reporting, and workflow development.
* Supporting environmental, natural resource, land management, engineering, or related programs.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain a Federal DOI clearance.

**Competencies \& Skills*** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Commitment to producing high\-quality technical deliverables.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:* Natural resources, environmental science, conservation, forestry, wildlife, water resources, or public lands management.
* ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, QuickCapture, Collector, or other mobile GIS platforms.
* Python or geoprocessing script development.

*Please be aware that some of our positions may require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.* *NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, FTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.* *NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.* *\#LI\-Remote*

jobs.title: GIS Analyst II
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Purpose:**


The GIS Analyst II is responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing geospatial data and workflows across multiple engineering and operational projects. This role utilizes both desktop and web\-based GIS applications to visualize, analyze, and share geospatial information internally and externally.




The GIS Analyst II works collaboratively with the GIS team, engineering, and project management groups, providing technical guidance, workflow improvements, and automation solutions to enhance efficiency and data integrity. This position requires advanced technical expertise in GIS data management, schema development, and spatial analysis, along with a strong ability to communicate and train others.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Edit, update, and manage GIS data in related platforms.
* Develop and maintain databases and data models to ensure consistency and standardization.
* Perform data conversions, exports, and translations
* Generate map products, dashboards, and web applications to support engineering and project teams.
* Provide technical support and training for GIS Portal users and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct QA/QC reviews to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and integrity across projects.
* Utilize Geoprocessing tools and spatial analysis to solve complex spatial problems and support decision\-making.
* Develop and document workflows, procedures, and system specifications for project implementation and process improvement.
* Interact with clients, subcontractors, and project teams to ensure reliable and efficient data integration and transfer.
* Identify and implement new GIS workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and team collaboration.
* Mentor and train GIS Technicians and Analysts on data standards, tools, and system usage.




**Key Measures / Key Performance Indicators:**

* Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of GIS deliverables
* Effectiveness of automation and workflow improvements
* Quality and integrity of SDE database structures
* Internal stakeholder and client satisfaction with GIS support
* Adherence to data and documentation standards

**Requirements**
================

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in **Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geospatial Sciences, or related technical field**, or equivalent experience.




**Experience:**

* Minimum 6\+ years of professional GIS experience, preferably in engineering, utilities, or telecommunications.
* Advanced proficiency in Field Maps environments.
* Strong knowledge of spatial analysis, schema design, and database management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to see high\-level project goals while managing detailed technical execution.
* Telecom industry experience or familiarity with telecommunications data preferred.

**Exposure**


* Frequent collaboration with Engineering, Project Management, and Field Operations teams.
* Interaction with clients, subcontractors, and external data providers.
* Exposure to telecommunications infrastructure data, GIS system architecture, and process automation initiatives.




* **Factors critical to success at ITG Communications for this position:**
* High technical proficiency and strong attention to detail in geospatial data management.
* Collaborative mindset and communication skills to support cross\-functional teams.
* Continuous improvement orientation, identifying automation and workflow efficiencies to advance GIS performance.




**Physical Requirements**:


* Primarily office\-based with extended use of a computer.
* Must be able to sit for long periods and occasionally lift up to 25 lbs.
* Occasional travel for training or team coordination may be required.

**Additional Comments**
=======================


ITG is an equal employment opportunity employer. ITG’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. ITG also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also ITG’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.
